# S1.3 — Land the provenance & authority model (§8.1/§8.5, R-2.1.5)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §8.1 (R-2.1.5) · §8.5 (schema ownership) · ADR-0033/0034/0035
(as amended) · **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/007_S1.3__provenance-authority.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.1.5**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.2` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 · **Live stage:** offline-only

## Summary
Lands the C0/Stage-1 §8.1 provenance & authority model as a new **persistent** workspace crate
`crates/hh-provenance` — the E1 *build binding* (CC4). Exactly **one** `ProvenanceRecord` and
**one** seven-class `AuthorityClass` exist in the tree (CC1 anchors here); authority is always
conferred by the minting table or a legitimate endorsement, never read from content and never
silently widened (CC2 anchors here). **Closes DF-S1.2-1**: `VersionedRef.provenance` and
`RevocationRecord.provenance` now *are* the canonical record, and the `publish` widening/`hh/`
namespace rules read the real `AuthorityClass`. `hh-baseline`'s throwaway
`ProvenanceRecord`/`AuthorityClass` are retired — `provenance.rs` becomes a thin adapter whose
three §9.1 hand-stamps mint through the canonical paths.

## What changed
- **`crates/hh-provenance/`** (new, persistent workspace member; sits **below** `hh-identity`,
  depends on `hh-wire` only — records carry identity *coordinates* as `String`s, never a
  `VersionedRef`, so no recursion; the typed `Ref<T>` projection lands at S1.4). Modules:
  `authority` (the seven classes `Unverified<External<Environment<Delegate<Principal<Definition<
  Kernel` + `TaintTag`/`ReaderSet`/`PersistenceScope`/`OpacityReport`), `origin` (`Origin` sum +
  total `default_authority`/`default_text_authority` — R-TEXT), `label` (`Label`, `join`/`meet`/
  `leq`, P6 transition check, `context_label`, `effective_authority`), `record` (the one
  `ProvenanceRecord`, `Derivation`, `Attestation`, `validate`, `require_provenance`,
  `MissingProvenance`), `derive` (P1 + subagent-result ingestion + delegate attenuation),
  `endorse` (closed `EndorsementBasis` six, `seal`, `endorse`, `declassify`, check-5),
  `monitor` (checks 1/2/7), `lower` (P7 lower/lift with declared `LoweringLoss`, RP role
  placement), `mandatory` (mandatory-provenance event table + append-time check + text-leaf/
  opacity helpers); `tests/acceptance.rs` (AC-R-2.1.5-{1,2}).
- **`crates/hh-identity/`** — `refs` re-exports canonical `hh_provenance::{Origin,
  ProvenanceRecord}` + `pub type Provenance = ProvenanceRecord` (CC8 additive, the same type —
  not a second scheme); `names::publish` reads `AuthorityClass::Principal` + attestation for
  widening successors and `AuthorityClass::Kernel` for `hh/`; `supersede::RevocationRecord`
  carries the canonical record.
- **`crates/hh-baseline/`** — `provenance.rs` retired to a thin adapter: re-exports the
  canonical types; `principal()`/`definition()`/`external()` mint through canonical paths so
  every stamp `validate`s; `hir.rs`/`context.rs`/`Cargo.toml` updated; `to_json` shape and
  trace byte-equality preserved.
- **Build memory:** `docs/adr/ADR-0230` (+ regenerated index); `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` —
  `DF-S1.2-1`→DONE, `DF-S1.3-1`/`DF-S1.3-2`/`DF-S1.3-3`→OPEN; `docs/build/runs/S1.3.md`;
  `docs/build/BUILD_INDEX.md` + `docs/build/LEDGER.md`.

## Design decisions
- **Crate shape (ADR-0230).** `hh-provenance` below `hh-identity`; provenance refs are
  `String` coordinates — a record embedded *in* a `VersionedRef` cannot recursively contain one.
- **Conservative Stage-1 minting (floors, never coercion).** `tool`→`external` (DF-S1.3-3:
  `environment` awaits sealed-definition closed-world declarations; the `validator` endorsement
  is the interim route); `participant`→`unverified` (DF-S1.3-2: the `≤ delegate` claim class
  awaits the Hosting ABI — never coerced upward, T-LCD-07).
- **Semantic correction (ADR-0230).** The canonical order puts `principal < definition`; the
  retired Stage-0 subset had it inverted. Baseline `context_label` for a definition+principal
  context now correctly yields `principal` — the principal's task text caps the assembled
  context.
- **HIR-node/edge carriage → S1.4 (DF-S1.3-1).** AC-R-2.1.5-1's full form needs the HIR/1
  document type (R-2.1.2); this PR lands the executable Stage-1 half — the record, the
  `MissingProvenance` check, the mandatory event table, text-leaf classification + opacity.
- **Process note.** Run was interrupted mid-Phase-2 and resumed from the run ledger per the
  implement-spec resume rule; recorded in ADR-0230. No design was improvised at resume.

## Deviations / deferrals
- **ADR-0230** — crate shape below `hh-identity`; conservative Stage-1 minting floors; baseline
  hand-stamps on the canonical record; records the interrupted-worker resume + the
  `ResolveOutcome` clippy `allow` (boxing would change the public enum's shape for no gain).
- **DF-S1.2-1 → DONE** — canonical record in `VersionedRef`/`RevocationRecord`; publish rules
  read `AuthorityClass`; single record type in the tree.
- **DF-S1.3-1 → OPEN** — HIR-node/edge `ProvenanceRecord` carriage + `MissingProvenance` in
  HIR/1 `validate` → S1.4.
- **DF-S1.3-2 → OPEN** — `participant` `≤ delegate` mint for ABI-vouched claims → Hosting ABI
  (Stage 2); mints `unverified` now.
- **DF-S1.3-3 → OPEN** — `tool` → `environment` direct mint → sealed-definition closed-world
  declarations; `external` floor + `validator` endorsement interim.

## Cross-cutting invariants
**CC1 anchors** (one `ProvenanceRecord`/`AuthorityClass`; baseline second record retired) ·
**CC2 anchors** (authority from the minting table/legitimate endorsement only —
`AuthorityExceedsOrigin`, closed `EndorsementBasis`, conservative floors) · **CC3 anchors**
(lowering loss declared via `LoweringLoss`, never silent; `unverified` never coerced) · CC4
(language-neutral records; this crate is the E1 build binding) · CC8 (additive swap — `Provenance`
alias keeps paths resolving to the same type; baseline API/`to_json` preserved) · CC5/CC7 — no
new external deps (hermetic; `hh-wire` only); schema source untouched — re-checked in
`docs/build/runs/S1.3.md#gap-table`.
